scope: Independent selected-source review, separate from worker full-caption/core-paper reading and later page review. No source execution or audio verification.

readings.read: Full extracted handout text, not slide figures or recording
findings: Pre/non-residual norm, RMSNorm, gated FFN and head-width conventions are design choices rather than universal rules.
PaLM head table gives48*258/18432, inconsistent with displayed ratio1.48; do not silently copy all values as verified facts.
MQA slide's one dimension means a shared KV head/group, not scalar key/value features.
GQA/MQA and local/global attention already appear in L03; L04 should reference rather than duplicate them.

readings.read: Full extracted handout text, not slide figures or recording
findings: Q(K^T V) reordering is not a reordering of softmax attention; conditions must be explicit.
Increasing expert count at fixedtop-k leaves selected expert MLP main FLOPs similar, not router/memory/communication free.
V3 closing slide saysV2 and258 while earlier table says256; treat as source conflict, not certified model specification.
Load-balancing, z-loss and capacity/token-dropping statements are mechanism-specific, not universal to every MoE service.

readings.read: Selected RMSNorm/Transformer/RoPE interfaces, SGD boundary, A1§4.3–4.5 and training/scaling requirements
findings: Fixed Algorithm1 starts t=1, applies decay with base step alpha before moment-adjusted update.
Bias correction enters alpha_t; epsilon is outside the uncorrected sqrt(v), not identical to the same epsilon under sqrt(v-hat).
Clipping uses aggregate gradient norm, not per-parameter clipping; data windows require one extra target token.
Standard and official low-resource token budgets/loss targets are separate; not equivalent completion.

readings.read: Core architecture/attention/position/complexity and optimizer schedule; selected neighboring context
findings: 2017 architecture is encoder-decoder/post-LN, not the A1 modern decoder-only specification.
Table1 attention interaction complexity does not include all projection/FFN terms; logarithmic convolution path is dilated-case conditional.
§5.3 uses original inverse-square-root warmup schedule, not A1 cosine schedule.

readings.read: Core§2–3.3 and§3.4.2 text; not full paper or Main visual formula audit
findings: R(m)^T R(n)=R(n-m) with column-vector convention. Main flagged Eq16; paper owner then visually confirmed the original PDF itself omits a subscript/transpose. Body explicitly distinguishes editorial correction from original formula.
Eq19 keeps denominator unrotated; rotated numerator weights can be negative and are not softmax probabilities.
Relative dependence and norm preservation do not guarantee long-context extrapolation or monotonic decay for arbitrary fixed vectors.

handoff: Findings sent to relevant owners before final writing. Final body corrections and acceptance are recorded in P3-REVIEW.txt and p3-acceptance.json.
